name: Vampire†Hunter
source:
A wounded vampire hunter enters an abandoned castle ruins in pursuit of his prey, but killing a vampire isn't easy...

This is a short visual novel about a wounded vampire hunter, who's trying to kill his elusive target.

[From [url=https://ebbasuke.itch.io/vampirehunter]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名受伤的吸血鬼猎人进入一座废弃的城堡废墟追捕他的猎物，但杀死吸血鬼并不容易……

这是一部关于受伤的吸血鬼猎人试图杀死难以捉摸的目标的简短视觉小说。

[来自[url=https://ebbasuke.itch.io/vampirehunter]Itch.io[/url]]
